step1.title: Welcome to Everyday
step1.body: This is your Today view. See what needs doing now, in plain language.

step2.title: Next action
step2.body: Tap the hero card to start your most important task.

step3.title: Your fields
step3.body: Tap Fields to see your groves. Tap Tasks to see all open work.

step4.title: More tools
step4.body: Calendar, Ministry, and Settings live in More.

step5.title: Ready to go
step5.body: You can switch to Full picture anytime in Settings.

step1.title: Welcome to Full picture
step1.body: Control-room density with maps, analytics, and field intelligence.

step2.title: Dashboard stats
step2.body: See your fields, tasks, and overdue items at a glance.

step3.title: Field detail
step3.body: Maps, lifecycle stepper, cadastre, and satellite layers all in one scroll.

step4.title: Analytics
step4.body: Aggregations and reports when you need the full picture.

step5.title: Ready to work
step5.body: Switch back to Everyday anytime in Settings for a simpler view.
